name: Lucky Dragon Hibachi
facts: Lucky Dragon Hibachi is in Compton, California.
Hours: Mon–Thu 11:00a–9:00p, Fri–Sat 11:00a–10:00p, Sun 12:00p–8:00p.
The exact street address isn't listed in the app yet. Use the Directions button.
Instagram: @luckydragon360.
Hibachi Catch is a free 30-second game. No account is needed to play.
You need a free member account only to save a score or claim a prize.
Catch food: +10 each. Gold star: +50. Dodge flame, candy and ice: −20 each.
Dragon fire costs −30. Three dragon hits end the run.
Catching in a row builds a streak bonus: +2 per catch, up to +10 extra.
A run of 650+ points puts you on the weekly board and earns 15% off your next meal.
Weekly board: 1st place wins 50% off your next meal, 2nd place wins 20% off.
The board runs Monday through Sunday and resets every Monday.
Free Daily Spin: one spin per member per day, and every slice wins something.
Spin prizes: +50, +75 or +100 points, $2 off a hibachi plate, free extra Yum-Yum, free fried rice, or 10% off your order.
Spin food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at the Compton location, one reward per visit.
Reward ladder: 250 pts = free extra Yum-Yum, 500 = free fried rice, 800 = free hibachi plate, 1,300 = dinner for two.
New-member offer: free extra Yum-Yum plus 10% off your next plate.
Refer a friend: you get a free fried rice.
Show this at the counter for double stars on today's order (nearby offer in the app).
No purchase is needed to play or win. Buying doesn't improve your chances.
Accounts need a name, phone number and email. It's one account per person and per phone.
Players must be 13 or older. Under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's permission.
Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.
Text and email offers are opt-in. Reply STOP to unsubscribe.
Prizes never include alcohol.
Menu: Hibachi Chicken, Steak, Shrimp, Chicken + Shrimp Combo, Premium Lobster, Fried Rice, Noodles, Extra Yum-Yum.
Premium Lobster is market price (MP).
You can build your own plate in the app and place an order.
Seasonal specials run on set dates, like Dragon Fire Night Oct 20–31.
The app has a language menu with 12 languages.
You can add the app to your Home Screen.
The app works with game controllers.

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Mon–Thu 11:00a–9:00p, Fri–Sat 11:00a–10:00p, and Sunday 12:00p–8:00p.

qa.q: Are you open today?
qa.a: We're open every day. Hours are Mon–Thu 11a–9p, Fri–Sat 11a–10p, Sun 12p–8p. Call 562-564-9200 to check on holidays.

qa.q: What time do you close?
qa.a: We close at 9:00p Mon–Thu, 10:00p Fri–Sat, and 8:00p on Sunday.

qa.q: What time do you open?
qa.a: We open at 11:00a Monday through Saturday, and 12:00p on Sunday.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: We're in Compton, California. The app doesn't list the exact street address yet, so tap Directions to open Google Maps.

qa.q: What's your address?
qa.a: I don't have the exact street address in the app. Tap the Directions button for Google Maps, or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the Directions button in the app to open Google Maps for Lucky Dragon Hibachi in Compton.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: Call us at 562-564-9200. You can also tap Call to order in the app.

qa.q: Can I order by phone?
qa.a: Yes. Tap Call to order in the app, or dial 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Can I order from my phone in the app?
qa.a: Yes. Build your plate in the app, fire it on the grill, then tap Place order.

qa.q: Do you have delivery?
qa.a: I don't have delivery info. Please ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Do you take reservations?
qa.a: I don't have reservation info. Please call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: I don't have payment details in the app. Please ask staff.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: Hibachi Chicken, Hibachi Steak, Hibachi Shrimp, Chicken + Shrimp Combo, and Premium Lobster. Sides are Fried Rice, Noodles and Extra Yum-Yum.

qa.q: How much does the food cost?
qa.a: The prices in the app are samples, not final menu prices. Please ask staff or call 562-564-9200. Premium Lobster is market price.

qa.q: What's the Premium Lobster?
qa.a: It's perfectly grilled lobster served hibachi style. You can add it to any meal. It's market price (MP).

qa.q: What is the Chicken + Shrimp Combo?
qa.a: It's a combo plate of chicken and shrimp. It's on the menu in the app.

qa.q: What comes with the hibachi plates?
qa.a: Chicken comes with grilled chicken, fried rice, veggies and house yum-yum. Steak comes with sirloin, fried rice, veggies and double yum-yum. Shrimp comes with jumbo shrimp, fried rice and veggies.

qa.q: What sides do you have?
qa.a: Fried Rice (wok-fired, egg and scallion), Noodles (garlic butter hibachi noodles), and Extra Yum-Yum.

qa.q: Can I build my own plate?
qa.a: Yes. In the app, pick a base (fried rice, chow mein or half & half), add proteins, and top it with veggies or yum-yum.

qa.q: What proteins can I add to a built plate?
qa.a: Chicken, steak, shrimp, salmon and scallops. You can add up to 2 each of chicken, steak and shrimp, and 1 each of salmon and scallops.

qa.q: Do you have salmon or scallops?
qa.a: Both are options in the plate builder in the app.

qa.q: Can I get extra yum-yum sauce?
qa.a: Yes. Extra Yum-Yum is on the menu, and in the plate builder you can add up to 2.

qa.q: Do you have vegetarian options?
qa.a: The app has hibachi veggies, fried rice and noodles. I don't have more detail, so please ask staff about ingredients.

qa.q: Do you have allergy info?
qa.a: I don't have allergy details. Please tell staff about any allergies before you order.

qa.q: Do you serve alcohol?
qa.a: I don't have drink or alcohol info. Please ask staff. Our app prizes never include alcohol.

qa.q: Are there any specials right now?
qa.a: Dragon Fire Night runs Oct 20–31. It features Hibachi Steak with Extra Yum-Yum (code BOO). These are sample specials, so confirm with staff.

qa.q: What holiday specials do you have?
qa.a: The app lists Dragon Fire Night (Oct 20–31), Family Hibachi Feast (Nov 20–28), Holiday Lobster Hibachi (Dec 15–25), Long-Life Noodles (Dec 29–Jan 1), Hibachi for Two (Feb 7–14), Lucky Dragon Day (Mar 14–17), Cinco Hibachi Shrimp (May 1–5) and Fourth of July Grill (Jul 1–4). Please confirm the final deals with staff.

qa.q: What is Dragon Fire Night?
qa.a: It's a Halloween special running Oct 20–31: Hibachi Steak with Extra Yum-Yum, straight off the flames. The code is BOO.

qa.q: Do you have a happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have happy hour info in the app. Please ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: How do I join the rewards club?
qa.a: Make a free member account with your name, phone number and email. You can also sign up after a game run, when you want to save your score.

qa.q: Is it free to join?
qa.a: Yes. The member account is free, and no purchase is needed.

qa.q: What do I need to sign up?
qa.a: Your name, phone number and email. The account is tied to the phone you made it on.

qa.q: Can I have more than one account?
qa.a: No. It's one free account per person and per phone.

qa.q: How old do I need to be?
qa.a: You must be 13 or older. If you're under 18, you need a parent's or guardian's permission.

qa.q: Is there a kids mode?
qa.a: The app doesn't have a separate kids mode. Players 13 and up can play, and under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's OK.

qa.q: How do points work?
qa.a: You earn reward points from the Daily Spin and from purchases. You trade them for rewards in the app. Points have no cash value.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: I don't have a points-per-dollar number in the app. Please ask staff.

qa.q: How many points per visit?
qa.a: I don't have a per-visit point amount. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Do I get points for playing the game?
qa.a: The game earns you a chance at weekly board prizes and discounts, not points. The Daily Spin can give you reward points.

qa.q: What rewards can I get?
qa.a: At 250 points: free extra Yum-Yum. At 500: free fried rice. At 800: free hibachi plate. At 1,300: dinner for two.

qa.q: How many points for a free hibachi plate?
qa.a: A free hibachi plate costs 800 points.

qa.q: How many points for dinner for two?
qa.a: Dinner for two costs 1,300 points.

qa.q: How many points for free fried rice?
qa.a: Free fried rice costs 500 points.

qa.q: How many points for free Yum-Yum?
qa.a: A free extra Yum-Yum costs 250 points. It's the first reward on the ladder.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Winners may be asked to show the code on their phone and a matching account at the counter. Ask staff if you need help.

qa.q: Is there a welcome offer for new members?
qa.a: Yes. The app lists a free extra Yum-Yum plus 10% off your next plate for joining.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: The reward ladder has four steps: 250, 500, 800 and 1,300 points. I don't have details on member levels. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Is there a birthday reward?
qa.a: I don't have birthday club info. Please ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Can I refer a friend?
qa.a: Yes. The referral gift in the app is a free fried rice. Ask staff how it's credited.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for checking in or visiting early?
qa.a: The app offers a counter deal: show it at the counter for double stars on today's order. I don't have early-bird info.

qa.q: What is the Daily Spin?
qa.a: It's a free wheel you spin once a day as a member. Every slice wins something, like points, a discount or a free item.

qa.q: How often can I spin the wheel?
qa.a: One spin per member per day (Los Angeles time). Spins are always free and never sold.

qa.q: What can I win on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: +50, +75 or +100 reward points, $2 off a hibachi plate, free extra Yum-Yum, free side of fried rice, or 10% off your order.

qa.q: What are the odds on the spin?
qa.a: +50 points 30%, +100 points 20%, +75 points 15%, $2 off a plate 15%, free extra Yum-Yum 8%, free fried rice 7%, 10% off your order 5%.

qa.q: How long are spin prizes good for?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at the Compton location. It's one reward per visit, and they can't be combined, have no cash value and can't be transferred.

qa.q: Do I have to buy something to spin or play?
qa.a: No. The spin and the game are free. A purchase doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: What is Hibachi Catch?
qa.a: It's our 30-second catching game. Slide the tray to catch hibachi food and dodge the stuff that doesn't belong, plus the dragon's fire.

qa.q: How do I play Hibachi Catch?
qa.a: Tap to start, then slide your finger across the game to move the tray. Catch the food as it falls, and dodge flames, candy, ice and the dragon's fire.

qa.q: What do I catch in the game?
qa.a: Chicken, steak, shrimp, lobster, veggies, chow mein, fried rice and drinks. Each is worth +10.

qa.q: What should I dodge?
qa.a: Flames, candy and ice each cost −20 and reset your streak. The dragon's fire costs −30.

qa.q: What is the gold star?
qa.a: It's a rare pickup worth +50 that keeps your streak going.

qa.q: How does the streak bonus work?
qa.a: Catch food in a row without a miss and you get +2 per catch, up to +10 extra. Once your streak hits 5, each catch is +20.

qa.q: How does the dragon work?
qa.a: The dragon locks onto your tray with a dashed red line, then breathes fire. Slide away. Three hits burn your food and end the run.

qa.q: How long is a game?
qa.a: 30 seconds, or less if the dragon hits you 3 times.

qa.q: How often can I play Hibachi Catch?
qa.a: As often as you like. It's free and needs no account.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play?
qa.a: No. You only need a free member account to save your score or claim a prize after a run.

qa.q: How do I win a prize in the game?
qa.a: Score 650 or more in one run for 15% off your next meal. Or finish first or second on the weekly board for a bigger discount.

qa.q: What's the weekly prize?
qa.a: 1st place (the highest score Monday through Sunday) wins 50% off their next meal. 2nd place wins 20% off.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The highest score from Monday through Sunday close wins. The board resets every Monday. Ties go to the score posted first.

qa.q: What score gets me on the board?
qa.a: 650 points or more in one run puts you on the weekly board and wins 15% off your next meal.

qa.q: When does the weekly board reset?
qa.a: Every Monday, with new winners each week.

qa.q: Are the game prizes real?
qa.a: The prizes in the app are set by the restaurant. The demo board names are samples. Ask staff to confirm current prizes.

qa.q: Is the game rigged or random?
qa.a: Hibachi Catch is a game of skill. Food falls in a varied pattern, but prizes depend only on your score and rank. The Daily Spin is the chance-based part.

qa.q: What happens if someone cheats?
qa.a: Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: What is the lantern in the game?
qa.a: A paper lantern drifts down once a run. Catch it on your tray for a +300 bonus. It links to Antidote The Foodie's review of Lucky Dragon.

qa.q: What is the halftime video?
qa.a: After about 90 seconds of total play, the next run opens with a short break that shows clips of Antidote The Foodie's review. You can skip it.

qa.q: Can I use a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. The game works with Xbox, PlayStation and Switch-style controllers in supported browsers. Press any button to connect, and use the stick or D-pad to slide the tray.

qa.q: Can the game go full screen?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the full screen button, and the lock button if you don't want the page to scroll while you play.

qa.q: Can I change the language?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the 🌐 button at the top right. The languages are English, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai and Russian.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: Use Add to Home Screen. On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, then Add. On Android, use the Install button or the ⋮ menu. The app will suggest it too.

qa.q: Do you have trivia or sports features?
qa.a: I don't see trivia or sports in the Lucky Dragon app. The game is Hibachi Catch.

qa.q: Can I order from my table with a QR code?
qa.a: I don't have table QR ordering info. You can order in the app or by phone at 562-564-9200, or ask staff.

qa.q: Where can I see your Instagram?
qa.a: We're @luckydragon360. Posts and reels show in the app, and you can tap to follow.

qa.q: Can I leave a Google review?
qa.a: Yes, there's a button in the app that opens Google. Reviews don't earn points or prizes, so please be honest.

qa.q: What happens to my personal info?
qa.a: It's used only for your rewards account and is never sold. Texts and emails are opt-in, and you can stop them anytime by replying STOP.

qa.q: Can employees win prizes?
qa.a: Employees and their household members may play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: Where can I read the official rules?
qa.a: There's an official rules link in the app under Game & daily spin. Those rules are still a draft. Questions? Call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Who do I ask for help?
qa.a: Ask any staff member, or call 562-564-9200.
